item.text:
As of **October 18, 2026**, using standard API pricing for regular paid inference, the flagship rates are:

| Provider | Flagship model | Input / 1M tokens | Output / 1M tokens |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Anthropic | Claude Opus 5.5 | $4 | $20 |
| OpenAI | GPT-6 Astra | $5 | $25 |
| Google | Gemini 4 Argon | $2 | $10 |

Anthropic lists Opus 5.5 at $4/$20 per million tokens. [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/opus) OpenAI’s pricing page lists GPT-6 Astra’s standard rates at $5/$25 for short context. [OpenAI](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing) Google lists Gemini 4 Argon at $2/$10 through November 30, 2026; its rates are scheduled to rise to $4/$20 on December 1. [Google](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing)

These are per-token rates; cached tokens, batch processing, and other service tiers can have different prices.
